newsitem.title: USA: Elizabeth Taylor back in hospital.
newsitem.headline: Elizabeth Taylor back in hospital.

text.p: Actress Elizabeth Taylor, who underwent brain surgery less than two weeks ago, was readmitted to a hospital on Saturday after suffering a mild seizure, her publicist said.
Taylor underwent four hours of surgery on Feb. 20 to remove an apparently benign tumour the size of a golf ball from the lining of her brain.
Shirene Coburn, Taylor's publicist, said seizures are a common side effect of brain surgery.
"She's up and alert, she's fine," Coburn said. "She's undergoing routine tests and hopefully she'll be home tomorrow (Sunday)."
Taylor celebrated her 65th birthday on Thursday, one day after she was released from the hospital.
